participant_id.Description: Unique participant label. Subjects ending in `p` (e.g. sub-1p) hold the preprocessed counterparts of the raw recordings under the same numeric id (e.g. sub-1).

Group.Description: Numeric group label assigned in the source release. The dataset documents this column only as `Participant group label`; the per-group semantics are not described further in the source. See the dataset README and source publication for additional context.
